FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T06:25:11.465Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:25:11.465Z"
        AND falco.output_fields.container.id == "ffbff1299702"
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY rule      = falco.rule,
           proc      = falco.output_fields.proc.name,
           cmdline   = falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline
| SORT events DESC
